timing_and_privacy_limits: Packet PTS/time base establishes media order only. No input DOWN/UP, device monotonic or host UTC alignment. Complete recorded-frame coverage does not establish continuous on-device privacy between encoded frames or beyond clips.

process_status.basis: All reviewer exec commands completed with exit 0; no background, native, build or decoder process was launched by this reviewer. Sole decoder process ownership belongs to /root/ui_game and is not inspected here.

restart_steps: Resume only when user authorizes continuation.
Keep completed observations and bindings; do not re-view completed exact-byte representatives.
Obtain frozen callbacks from /root/ui_game for 3d-seascape-rotation, 3d-split-entry, 3d-split-exit; none was delivered at pause.

Bind each new set with bind_frame_set.py and its callback freeze SHA, then directly inspect every exact-byte representative using view_image detail original; record each already viewed batch with record_views.py.

Build final per-clip/frame receipts and media-order state sequences after all remaining frames are reviewed, then freeze this new supplement and hand it to /root and /root/review_design. Do not publish.
constraints: No product/shared edits, Git, downloads, archive extraction, video decoding, crops/collages/resizing, bulk media copies, builds or native/device execution; private metadata/receipt work only. Preserve older frozen reviews.
